name: 1bb-connect
description: Connect your own 1BB account to Claude Desktop. Read your goals, training, Voice DNA and shared sources, and save drafts to your 1BB Library.
long_description: 1BB Connect lets Claude read the parts of your 1BB account you chose to share when you made your connection key: your business brief, goals, training, Voice DNA and Second Brain sources. Claude can import a call into your Gallery, save drafts to your 1BB Library and prepare a post for your review. Claude can never approve or publish. You approve every post inside 1BB. Your key keeps working while your membership is active and stops if it ends.

connection_token.title: 1BB connection key
connection_token.description: Create it in 1BB: Settings, then Connect. It starts with 1bbct_ and works while your membership is active. It is stored in your computer's secure keychain. Never paste it into a chat.

tools.name: onebb_connection_status
tools.description: Check connection permissions, expiry and available tools.

tools.name: onebb_get_context
tools.description: Read the connected main business's brief.

tools.name: onebb_get_voice_rules
tools.description: Read a bounded, safe projection of the connected member's Voice DNA.

tools.name: onebb_list_goals
tools.description: List a bounded page of the connected member's goals.

tools.name: onebb_search_training
tools.description: Search active 1BB training by title and description.

tools.name: onebb_get_training
tools.description: Read one active 1BB training module and the connected member's watch state without exposing storage details or changing progress.

tools.name: onebb_search_sources
tools.description: Search consented, active Second Brain sources.

tools.name: onebb_get_source
tools.description: Read one consented source with citation metadata.

tools.name: onebb_list_content
tools.description: List a bounded page of the connected member's Library.

tools.name: onebb_get_content
tools.description: Read an exact Library draft and its version before editing or preparing a post.

tools.name: onebb_save_draft
tools.description: Save one platform's version of a post (or ordered carousel copy) to the member's Library.

tools.name: onebb_update_draft
tools.description: Change any detail of an unapproved draft: the caption (body), the title, or the text of single carousel slides (by slide_number).

tools.name: onebb_list_destinations
tools.description: List the member's connected accounts (no credentials): Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Telegram and Google Business.

tools.name: onebb_prepare_publish
tools.description: Line up one post on one account for the member's approval in 1BB.

tools.name: onebb_publish
tools.description: Post or schedule one post on one account WITHOUT the 1BB review page.

tools.name: onebb_publish_everywhere
tools.description: Post the same idea on several accounts with ONE yes: 'post this everywhere'.

tools.name: onebb_preview_video_post
tools.description: Show the member a video post before it goes anywhere.

tools.name: onebb_post_video
tools.description: The one step for posting a video the member has: 'post my video', 'put this video everywhere'.

tools.name: onebb_preview_words_post
tools.description: Show the member their own words as a post before it goes anywhere: 'post this quote', 'tweet this'.

tools.name: onebb_post_words
tools.description: The one step for posting the member's own words: a quote, a thought, a tweet.

tools.name: onebb_get_publish_status
tools.description: Read the current state of this connection's publish request.

tools.name: onebb_cancel_post
tools.description: Cancel a post before it goes out: give request_id for one this AI lined up, or post_id from onebb_list_posts for any scheduled post.

tools.name: onebb_reschedule_post
tools.description: Move one of the member's scheduled posts (post_id from onebb_list_posts) to a new exact time.

tools.name: onebb_retry_post
tools.description: Try a failed post again (post_id from onebb_list_posts, status failed).

tools.name: onebb_delete_draft
tools.description: Delete a draft from the member's Library.

tools.name: onebb_restore_draft
tools.description: Bring back a draft deleted with onebb_delete_draft, using its content_id.

tools.name: onebb_set_photos
tools.description: Set a written draft's photos to exactly this list, in posting order (2 or more post as a swipe set).

tools.name: onebb_delete_gallery_item
tools.description: Remove a photo, video or call from the member's Gallery (a photo_id, video_id from onebb_list_videos including a title box version, or call_id).

tools.name: onebb_restore_gallery_item
tools.description: Bring back a photo, video or call removed with onebb_delete_gallery_item.

tools.name: onebb_list_photos
tools.description: List the member's 1BB Gallery photos, newest first, with preview links.

tools.name: onebb_list_videos
tools.description: List the member's 1BB Gallery videos (b-roll clips and finished videos), newest first, with a thumbnail, length and edit_url.

tools.name: onebb_set_video
tools.description: Put one Gallery video on an unapproved written post (caption, post or tweet), or take it off with video_id null.

tools.name: onebb_set_title_box
tools.description: Put words on a Gallery video (1BB calls them a title box), change them, or take them off: "add a title box", "change the text on my video", "take the words off".

tools.name: onebb_add_photos
tools.description: Put 1 to 5 Gallery photos on an unapproved written draft, in the order given (2 or more post as a swipe set).

tools.name: onebb_start_photo_upload
tools.description: Only when you can run commands (Claude Code, Codex): start uploading a photo file the member gave you (jpg, png or webp, up to 50 MB).

tools.name: onebb_finish_photo_upload
tools.description: Finish a photo upload with its upload_ticket and the storageId the upload returned.

tools.name: onebb_start_file_upload
tools.description: Only when you can run commands (Claude Code, Codex): start putting a video or audio file the member gave you into their Gallery, up to 1 GB.

tools.name: onebb_finish_file_upload
tools.description: Finish a video or call upload after every part is sent.

tools.name: onebb_set_call_speakers
tools.description: When onebb_get_call says 1BB doesn't know which speaker is the member: show the member each speaker's sample line from onebb_get_call, ask which one is them, and send their answer here.

tools.name: onebb_mark_my_lines
tools.description: When onebb_get_call has lines_to_mark: the call came in as words with no names, so 1BB can't tell which lines the member said.

tools.name: onebb_retry_call
tools.description: When a call failed (status failed in onebb_list_calls or onebb_get_call) and the member wants it tried again.

tools.name: onebb_make_more_posts
tools.description: When the member wants more posts from a call that is already done ("make more posts from my Tuesday call").

tools.name: onebb_make_tweet_videos
tools.description: When the member wants their best tweets turned into videos ("turn my best tweets into videos", "put my tweets on B-roll").

tools.name: onebb_confirm_my_words
tools.description: When onebb_get_call lists tweets_on_hold: the member changed who is speaking on that call after these tweets were written, so 1BB holds them until the member vouches every word is theirs.

tools.name: onebb_ban_words
tools.description: When the member says never to use a word or phrase ("never say leverage", "stop using game-changer").

tools.name: onebb_remove_voice_rule
tools.description: When the member wants a writing rule gone ("you can say journey again").

tools.name: onebb_start_doc_upload
tools.description: Only when you can run commands (Claude Code, Codex): start adding a document the member gave you (a sales deck, an offer, notes, an FAQ) to their Second Brain, so 1BB can write posts from it.

tools.name: onebb_finish_doc_upload
tools.description: Finish adding a document with its upload_ticket and the storageId the upload returned.

tools.name: onebb_list_posts
tools.description: List the member's posts.

tools.name: onebb_find_best_posts
tools.description: Rank the member's own published posts on every connected account by the real numbers the platforms reported, best first.

tools.name: onebb_send_feedback
tools.description: Send the member's feedback to the 1BB team: a bug (something not working), an idea, or a question, in the member's own plain words; never include passwords, keys or private client details.

tools.name: onebb_help
tools.description: Plain answers about how 1BB Connect works: posting, photos, carousels, calls, analytics, tidying (delete and undo), feedback, limits.

tools.name: onebb_guide
tools.description: Read 1BB's step-by-step guide for a job before you do it, as the instructions say: setup, connections, profile, posting, editing, videos, carousels, calls, approving, schedule, fixing, results.

tools.name: onebb_list_calls
tools.description: List the member's calls and recordings in their Gallery (Zoom, Fathom, Granola, Notion, uploads), newest first, with short summaries.

tools.name: onebb_call_sources
tools.description: Where the member's calls can come from.

tools.name: onebb_week_from_call
tools.description: When the member says 'turn my last call into posts' or 'make me a week from my Zoom call'.

tools.name: onebb_get_call
tools.description: Read one call: summary, notes, transcript (long calls are cut off) and the posts 1BB already made from it.

tools.name: onebb_import_call
tools.description: Import one call the user chose into their 1BB Gallery.

tools.name: onebb_whats_waiting
tools.description: One check for 'what needs me?', 'anything waiting?' or 'what should I do today?': posts waiting in the Approve deck, failed posts, Auto-Pilot plan cards to OK, calls where 1BB needs to know which voice is the member, tweets on hold, and carousels asked for in chat that 1BB couldn't make (with the reason).

tools.name: onebb_list_approve_deck
tools.description: Read the member's Approve deck: the posts 1BB made that wait for a decision (show waiting), the whole board, the trash, or spread_plan (when Auto-Pilot would post the approved ones).

tools.name: onebb_decide_draft
tools.description: Decide on one post in the Approve deck, like the swipe in 1BB: approve (Auto-Pilot may post it; needs member_said_yes and direct posting), changes (send it back with the member's note), later (hide it for 7 days) or revise (you changed its words here).

tools.name: onebb_discard_draft
tools.description: Discard one post from the Approve deck.

tools.name: onebb_undo_decision
tools.description: Undo the latest decision on one post (approve, changes, later, revise or discard); it goes back into the deck.

tools.name: onebb_bring_back_saved
tools.description: Bring every post the member saved for later back into the Approve deck now.

tools.name: onebb_set_post_platforms
tools.description: Choose which accounts one post goes to (instagram, twitter for X, linkedin, threads, tiktok, youtube).

tools.name: onebb_approve_and_book
tools.description: Approve one post and book it at the next open Auto-Pilot time on every account it is set for, in one step.

tools.name: onebb_undo_approve_and_book
tools.description: Take back onebb_approve_and_book: cancels that post and puts the draft back in the deck.

tools.name: onebb_spread_approved
tools.description: Book posts at the member's Auto-Pilot times in one step, approving any still waiting.

tools.name: onebb_change_slides
tools.description: When the member wants a slide added, removed or moved ("add a slide after 2 about pricing", "drop the last slide", "make slide 4 the second one").

tools.name: onebb_set_slide_media
tools.description: When the member wants a Gallery photo behind a slide, the same photo behind every slide (every_slide), or a slide to play a video (video_id from onebb_list_videos, 3 to 60 seconds; null takes it off).

tools.name: onebb_adjust_slide_photo
tools.description: When a slide's photo is sideways, cut off or too close ("turn the cover photo", "show more of my face on slide 1").

tools.name: onebb_make_carousel
tools.description: When the member wants a new carousel made for them: from one of their written posts (post), on Gallery photos they pick (photos), or in a 1BB look: a post on X (x_post), handwritten on paper (pen_paper), one short line (simple_message), a photo with an X post card (photo_x), or this or that (this_or_that).

tools.name: onebb_edit_scheduled_post
tools.description: Change the words on a post that is already scheduled (post_id from onebb_list_posts), right where it sits on the calendar: the main words, one platform's own words (platform_words), or the first comment.

tools.name: onebb_change_post_accounts
tools.description: Change which accounts a scheduled post goes to (post_id from onebb_list_posts, accounts from onebb_list_destinations).

tools.name: onebb_get_autopilot
tools.description: Read Auto-Pilot, 1BB's posting schedule: on or off, timezone, and each rule (what, where, how often, what times) with in_words to show the member, plus the month plan's cards for the next days.

tools.name: onebb_set_autopilot
tools.description: Change Auto-Pilot: turn it on or off, the timezone, best_times, Facebook Pages, or the rules (send the full new list; read it first with onebb_get_autopilot).

tools.name: onebb_plan_month
tools.description: Lay out the month: 1BB fills Auto-Pilot's open times with the member's approved posts as plan cards.

tools.name: onebb_discard_plan
tools.description: Throw away every plan card waiting for review.

tools.name: onebb_approve_plan
tools.description: Approve plan cards so they are scheduled at their times: one card (card_id), or every card in a range (from and to, at most 31 days, e.g.

tools.name: onebb_post_plan_card_now
tools.description: Post one plan card in about a minute and a half instead of at its time.

tools.name: onebb_move_plan_card
tools.description: Move a plan card to a new time (with UTC offset).

tools.name: onebb_remove_plan_card
tools.description: Take one card off the plan; the post stays in the Library and 1BB won't put it back on its own.

tools.name: onebb_edit_plan_card
tools.description: Change a plan card before it is approved: which platforms it goes to, words for one platform (platform_words), or Instagram Trial Reel.

tools.name: onebb_set_trial_reel
tools.description: Turn Instagram Trial Reel on or off for a scheduled Instagram video (post_id from onebb_list_posts).

tools.name: onebb_put_photo_on_post
tools.description: Put one of the member's Gallery photos on a scheduled post as its first photo (post_id from onebb_list_posts, photo_id from onebb_list_photos).

tools.name: onebb_check_post_status
tools.description: Ask the platform what really happened to a failed or stuck post (it may have gone out after all).

tools.name: onebb_list_duplicates
tools.description: Find posts that repeat the same words or the same photo or video, scheduled or posted in the last 30 days.

tools.name: onebb_delete_post_copy
tools.description: Delete one scheduled, failed or cancelled post for good, usually a duplicate copy from onebb_list_duplicates.

tools.name: onebb_keep_duplicates
tools.description: When the member wants the copies on purpose: mark a set from onebb_list_duplicates as fine so 1BB stops warning about it.

tools.name: onebb_list_styles
tools.description: When the member wants a carousel to look different ("try another style", "make it look like my brand").

tools.name: onebb_set_carousel_style
tools.description: Switch a carousel to the style the member picked (style_id from onebb_list_styles), for the whole carousel or one slide (slide_number).

tools.name: onebb_suggest_photos
tools.description: When the member asks which photo fits a post or a carousel slide.

tools.name: onebb_get_carousel_settings
tools.description: Read how their carousels look and get made: brand kit (colors, fonts, tagline, the name and @handle on slides), the profession lens and its choices, whether 1BB makes carousels from every new call (auto_visuals), the starred style new carousels use, and up to 3 favorite styles.

tools.name: onebb_set_carousel_settings
tools.description: Change any of those after the member says yes to the exact change: brand_kit fields, profession (an id from the choices, or "off"), auto_visuals (on costs AI time on every call), starred_style_id (one of their own styles), or favorite_style_id with favorite true or false.

tools.name: onebb_manage_style
tools.description: Save a copy of any style they can use as their own (save_copy, then it can be starred or edited), rename one of their own styles, or delete one (needs member_said_yes; a style a saved carousel uses can't be deleted until that carousel switches style).

tools.name: onebb_onboarding_status
tools.description: Shows how far the member's 1BB account setup is: 5 setup questions about their business, business name, time zone, social accounts, turning on AI, a call or document in their Second Brain, their first post, Auto-Pilot posting times, and whether this AI may post for them.

tools.name: onebb_get_profile
tools.description: Shows the member's own details in one answer: their name, sign-in email and phone, their business name, description, location, website and Instagram handle, whether 1BB texts them and how often, and their plan with the date it renews or ends.

tools.name: onebb_update_profile
tools.description: Changes the member's name or business details (business name, description, location, website, Instagram handle) after they said yes to the exact new words.

tools.name: onebb_list_connected
tools.description: Shows everything hooked up to the member's 1BB account in one answer: their sign-in email and contact email, every social account they post on (several on one platform is fine) with how many posts are lined up for each, every Google Drive, Zoom and call app account that sends their calls and photos to 1BB (several of each is fine), and their other verified emails.

tools.name: onebb_list_drive_folders
tools.description: When the member wants to pick or change the Google Drive folder 1BB brings photos in from ("use my Instagram photos folder", "which folder are you watching?").

tools.name: onebb_set_photo_folder
tools.description: Make a folder from onebb_list_drive_folders the photo folder 1BB brings new photos in from.

tools.name: onebb_add_connection
tools.description: Gives the link and the one thing to tap to connect a new social account, Google Drive, Zoom or another call app.

tools.name: onebb_remove_connection
tools.description: Disconnects one social account, Google Drive, Zoom or call app account from the member's 1BB account.

tools.name: onebb_manage_email
tools.description: Adds, verifies or removes the member's other email addresses (besides the one they sign in with), after they said yes.

tools.name: onebb_set_contact_email
tools.description: Sets, changes or removes the contact email other 1BB members see in the Directory, after the member said yes to the exact email.

tools.name: onebb_change_sign_in_email
tools.description: Asks to change the email the member signs in to 1BB with, after they said yes to the exact new email.

tools.name: onebb_skip_setup_step
tools.description: Remembers that the member wants to skip a setup step or one setup question for now, so it shows as skipped (not done) and is not asked again.

tools.name: onebb_save_setup_answer
tools.description: Saves one setup answer to the member's 1BB account after they said yes to the exact words: one of the 5 setup questions, their business name, or their time zone.
